reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: mutual greater-of cap with the exact fee basis and claim anchor, the USD 1,000,000 floor, the retained mutual consequential-damages waiver, and the full carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP).
Minimality holds: the redline is a concise standalone insertion (new 16.6) addressing the absent direct-liability cap; Section 16.5 is left untouched and no other term is rewritten.

Intent concern: the insertion uses "Customer's payment obligations", but this Agreement defines only "Party" as "Array or Ono" and contains no defined "Customer", so an undefined term is introduced. Recommend substituting the paying Party's name (e.g., "Ono's payment obligations") to avoid a dangling reference.

Minor drafting note (not a deviation): "fees" is not a defined term in this collaboration/licence agreement, which uses milestones and royalties; consider anchoring the fee limb to the amounts payable under the Agreement.
